title: Pope John XXIII to broker the warhead destruction deal
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Pope John XXIII to broker the warhead destruction deal, about 1963 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Cruchef recommended that in order to verify that they were both complying with the actual not only the disassembly but the destruction of the nuclear warheads is that they were going to have Pope John the 23rd broker the whole deal

plain: A man named Dan Sheehan says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that in 1963 the United States and the Soviet Union were working toward taking apart and destroying their nuclear warheads. According to Sheehan, the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev proposed that Pope John XXIII, head of the Catholic Church, broker the whole deal so each side could check the other was keeping its word. If true, it would mean the two superpowers came close to a secret disarmament pact run through the Vatican.
